Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableProximi: Adds a read-only virtual container to the loot window containing items from the reachable containers already discovered by vanilla's bounded nearby-container scan.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableSeparat: Separate equipped items from carried inventory
Adds an Equipped container beside the character inventory and worn bags. Worn, held, and attached items appear there instead of in the general inventory list without changing actual ownership.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableInvento: Repairs grouped and individual row selection after the vanilla inventory list refreshes. Disable if an inventory overhaul conflicts with this compatibility patch.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableDeviceB: Group all device actions inside device menus
Moves activation, controls, alarms, bulb, and battery actions into the selected device's submenu while leaving generic inventory actions at the root.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableExactMi: Show exact minutes on the vanilla-style clock
Replaces the native clock face in the same position with an exact minute-ones digit while preserving mechanical and digital watch distinctions.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableAutoKey: Automatically file loose keys onto a carried key ring
Queues vanilla inventory-transfer actions for recognized loose keys. Public predicates allow modded keys and rings without hardcoded compatibility lists.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_AutoKeyRingPr: Leave favorited keys where they are
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_AutoKeyRingMa: Maximum automatic key transfers per game minute
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_SortingAllowC: Allow category matches when no exact item-type destination exists
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_SortingInclud: Search loaded containers on nearby floors
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_SortingMaxTra: Maximum items moved by one sorting operation
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_SortingAllowC: Exact full item types always take priority. Category fallback can conveniently seed new storage but is less precise, so it is disabled by default.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_BulkMagazines: Include magazines and ammunition in carried bags
Maximum magazines handled by one bulk action
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_RouteSawedPla: Place planks from sawed logs and branches on the ground
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_RouteHeavyCra: Place all heavy crafted outputs on the ground
Broad weight-based routing is disabled by default. Verified recipe-specific rules still work independently.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableHotbarR: Adds safe move-left and move-right actions to each hotbar slot's context menu. Slot order and attached-item indexes are saved together.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableMapSymb: Changes the initial size of newly placed map symbols and notes. Build 42's vanilla per-symbol scale slider remains available for individual adjustments.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableLiterat: Enable literature read and duplicate status
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableRecorde: Show watched status for VHS and recorded media
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableMediaRe: Show skill and recipe rewards on books and media
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_LiteratureInv: Maximum carried items checked for duplicate literature
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableLiterat: Adds a concise read-progress and carried-duplicate status to literature menus. Uses vanilla character knowledge and bounded carried-inventory checks; it never scans the world.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableRecorde: Uses the character's vanilla known-media lines to distinguish unwatched, partially watched, and fully watched tapes.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableMediaRe: Reads reward metadata from the item or recorded-media definition to identify skill multipliers, XP, and recipes without maintaining a hardcoded item list.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableContext: Moves multiple developer-only entries into one submenu while preserving each original callback, icon, tooltip, availability state, and child menu. Gameplay actions are never removed.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_LadderMaximum: Maximum connected ladder levels prepared per interaction
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEssentials_EnableLadderC: Recognizes vanilla and modded ladderW/N/E/S tile properties and routes climbing through the vanilla sheet-rope action and animation. No teleport fallback is used.
